occurrences.source_assessment: The article-linked formulation row identifies PH2 as Enterobacter ludwigii and includes it in SRC2v4. The article separately reports PH2 with SO8-2 and SO6b as abundant in planta. That abundance result does not identify its reference genome or define a pairwise interaction.
occurrences.population_scope: Exact species-ID correspondence reports total296 and fraction0.95; it does not provide an explicit support_genomes numerator. Do not reconstruct one from the rounded fraction. These are reference genomes, not PH2 cells, reads, experimental replicates or stock-identical assemblies.
occurrences.name_scope: Preserve PH2, canonical species identity and source name; the GTDB reference block does not resolve study-stock genome identity or prove ecological mechanisms.

occurrences.source_assessment: The retained Dataset S1 row places SAI_226, named Kribbella shirazensis, in SRC2v4. Preserve this stock independently of similarly numbered Streptomyces SAI_104 and other SRC2 variants.
occurrences.population_scope: Native exact species-ID result reports total3 and fraction1.0 with no support_genomes numerator. Reference population size is not the number of experimental SAI_226 genomes, cells or replicates.
occurrences.name_scope: Keep the species-level NCBI anchor and SAI_226 stock designation; no sequence, assembly or strain-level equivalence is inferred from generic reference correspondence.

occurrences.source_assessment: The source table names SO6a at Acinetobacter genus rank. It is distinct from Flavobacterium SO6b. The main text reports almost no SO6a transcriptional activity and context-dependent metabolite correlations; neither membership nor genus grounding certifies metabolic activity or mediation.
occurrences.population_scope: Native genus result explicitly reports21984 supporting of21984 reference genomes and fraction1.0. This does not identify the species or genome of SO6a and does not measure its experimental abundance.
occurrences.name_scope: Keep Acinetobacter at genus rank, SO6a as the source stock name and existing biological limits; do not choose a reference species or transfer functions from the genus population.

occurrences.source_assessment: Dataset S1 identifies NA8 as Pseudomonas entomophila in SRC2v4. Keep it distinct from the three genus-level Pseudomonas stocks TBS_028, NA2a and SO8-1 and from Pseudomonas model strains discussed in the article.
occurrences.population_scope: The native species-name route reports total2 and fraction1.0, not an explicit support_genomes numerator. These reference rows are not verified NA8 assemblies or experimental counts.
occurrences.name_scope: Retain the source Pseudomonas name and canonical NCBI species identity. Pseudomonas_E is the GTDB correspondence name, not a source stock rename or evidence for importing reference-strain traits.

occurrences.source_assessment: Dataset S1 places TBS_030, Chryseobacterium gleum, in SRC2v4. It is distinct from TBS_027, Chryseobacterium proteolyticum, whose native route is unresolved. Almost absent transcriptional activity of TBS030 in the reported assay does not negate its inoculum membership.
occurrences.population_scope: Native species-name correspondence reports total2 and fraction1.0 with no explicit support_genomes numerator; no experimental genome identity, abundance or replicate inference follows.
occurrences.name_scope: Preserve TBS_030 and its canonical species; do not use its match to fill the distinct unresolved TBS_027 descriptor.

records.historical_guard_assessment: Only selected indices3,6,11,13,14 GTDB fields and actual native inline events may change. Preserve all15stocks, eight existing mapping blocks, the two native-null descriptors0/1 as UNRESOLVED, source quotations, all three interaction observations with zero arrows, experimental conditions, discussions and old history. Native null is not affirmative NO_GTDB. Issue1811 is currently OPEN and is retained; this mapping does not close it or promote scientific status. Relative-abundance nonsignificance is not equivalence; source root-diversity claims conflict; live-treatment host biomass does not prove reciprocal microbial benefit or field efficacy; host flavonoid responses do not establish colonization mediation. SRC1 outperformed SRC2v4; a single formulation per selection strategy does not isolate the strategy's general effect. Preserve batch103's current biological predicates, old source/ledger hashes, unresolved SRC1 identity and other records.
